why: B delivers almost every piece the client named: a clean-lined beige sofa, a round wooden coffee table, a jute rug and a rice-paper lantern, all calm and Japandi on the dark floor. Its only miss is the modest ZZ plant in a plastic nursery pot. A drifts boho, with a busy patterned rug too small for the sofa, a carved drum table, a non-paper lamp and an uncovered palm, so it loses the serene, pared-back look.
